material.head: A* setup: wave 2 of wave 3
material.text: Five clean waves up from Mar 19 to Aug 17 (+41%, wave 1). The pullback has reached the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (+5.8% to −0.6%), with the May 15 low in the same place. It is the second wave of a larger wave 3: five waves up from May 23, 2025 to Jan 5 and a pullback of 0.75 of them to the Mar 19 low came first, so the end of this wave 2 starts wave 3 of 3, the strongest move a chart makes.
